lyrics.ja: Take off！
lyrics.en: Take off!

lyrics.ja: 上げてけ声量
lyrics.en: Pump up the volume

lyrics.ja: 紡ぐエピソードの先へ行こう！
lyrics.romaji: Tsumugu Episoodo no Saki e Ikou!
lyrics.en: Let's go beyond the episodes we weave!
lyrics.zh: 前往編織出的篇章彼端吧！

lyrics.ja: 茜色じゃなくて薄明色
lyrics.romaji: Akane Iro ja Nakute Hakumei Iro
lyrics.en: Not madder red, but the color of dawn
lyrics.zh: 不是茜紅色，而是薄明色

lyrics.ja: 正夢ってかまさに夢
lyrics.romaji: Masayume tte ka Masa ni Yume
lyrics.en: A prophetic dream, or rather, exactly a dream
lyrics.zh: 說是正夢，不如說根本就是夢

lyrics.ja: かなっちゃうのかい
lyrics.en: Is it really going to come true?

lyrics.ja: わらっちゃうくらい
lyrics.en: So much it makes me laugh

lyrics.ja: 長くて短い道のりの
lyrics.en: Of this long yet short journey
lyrics.zh: 在這既長又短的旅途中

lyrics.ja: 答えを、見つけよっ！
lyrics.en: Let's find the answer!

lyrics.ja: ああ　始まりだった　幕開けだった
lyrics.en: Ah, it was the beginning—it was the curtain rising
lyrics.zh: 啊啊，那是開始，那是揭幕

lyrics.ja: 僕らのストーリーだから
lyrics.en: Because it's our story

lyrics.ja: パーティー！Let's go, Let's go！
lyrics.en: Party! Let's go, let's go!

lyrics.ja: あれもこれもマルゴトミライ
lyrics.romaji: Are mo Kore mo Marugoto Mirai
lyrics.en: That and this—all of it, the future
lyrics.zh: 那個這個，全部都是未來

lyrics.ja: 歩いて　走って　走って　歩いて
lyrics.en: Walking, running, running, walking

lyrics.ja: つまずいて起き上がって
lyrics.en: Stumbling and getting back up

lyrics.ja: 笑って　泣いて　泣いて　笑って
lyrics.en: Laughing, crying, crying, laughing

lyrics.ja: 少しずつレベルアップ！
lyrics.en: Leveling up little by little!

lyrics.ja: 迷って　ぐるって　モヤって　解って
lyrics.en: Getting lost, going in circles, feeling foggy, understanding
lyrics.zh: 迷惘、團團轉、悶悶不樂、然後明白

lyrics.ja: 手繰り寄せたこの場所
lyrics.en: This place we pulled close
lyrics.zh: 將它拉到身邊的這個地方

lyrics.ja: 歌って　歌って　響かせた！
lyrics.en: Singing, singing—we made it resound!

lyrics.ja: この音を合図に
lyrics.en: With this sound as the signal

lyrics.ja: 繋がって
lyrics.en: Connecting

lyrics.ja: ここまできたから
lyrics.en: Because we've made it this far

lyrics.ja: 貫き通せ
lyrics.en: See it through

lyrics.ja: 高まる心拍数は
lyrics.en: The rising heart rate

lyrics.ja: 限界突破
lyrics.en: Breaks through the limits

lyrics.ja: メーター振り切ってけ
lyrics.en: Push the meter past its limit

lyrics.ja: 最高潮を再更新へ
lyrics.en: Toward renewing the climax once more

lyrics.ja: さあ　夢を語って　夜更かしあって
lyrics.romaji: Saa Yume wo Katatte Yofukashi Atte
lyrics.en: Now, talk about dreams, stay up late
lyrics.zh: 來吧，談論夢想，熬夜暢聊

lyrics.ja: 踊り明かそうか　キラリ
lyrics.en: Shall we dance until dawn? Sparkle

lyrics.ja: うんと　うんと
lyrics.en: So much, so much

lyrics.ja: おっきい「まさか！！」
lyrics.en: A huge "No way!!"

lyrics.ja: わー！　声を出そうぜ　心はそう絶対に
lyrics.romaji: Waa! Koe wo Dasou ze Kokoro ha Sou Zettai ni
lyrics.en: Whoa! Let's raise our voices—our hearts absolutely
lyrics.zh: 哇！大聲喊出來吧，心絕對是

lyrics.ja: ミライむきでワハハ
lyrics.en: Facing the future with a ha-ha

lyrics.ja: よっしゃ、よっしゃ！
lyrics.en: Alright, alright!

lyrics.ja: 目と目あわせ　乾杯！
lyrics.en: Eyes meeting eyes—cheers!

lyrics.ja: ぜんぶマルゴト期待してたい
lyrics.en: I want to look forward to all of it, everything
lyrics.zh: 想對全部、所有一切都抱有期待

lyrics.ja: 見てたい見せたい
lyrics.en: I want to see it, I want to show it

lyrics.ja: 叫んで YEAH！
lyrics.en: Shout—yeah!

lyrics.ja: いっせーので HEY！
lyrics.en: On the count—hey!

lyrics.ja: まだまだ行けるね？ついてきて！
lyrics.romaji: Mada Mada Ikeru ne? Tsuite Kite!
lyrics.en: We can still keep going, right? Follow me!
lyrics.zh: 還能繼續走下去吧？跟上來！

lyrics.ja: 駆け抜ける日もあったらいい
lyrics.en: It'd be nice to have days we race through
lyrics.zh: 能有奔馳而過的日子也不錯

lyrics.ja: 空見上げる日もあったり
lyrics.en: Days we look up at the sky too

lyrics.ja: あっちこっち寄り道したり
lyrics.en: Taking detours here and there

lyrics.ja: でもそれがなんだかいい感じ！
lyrics.romaji: Demo Sore ga Nandaka Ii Kanji!
lyrics.en: But somehow that feels just right!

lyrics.ja: 最初のひとことも　最後のひとかけらも
lyrics.romaji: Saisho no Hitokoto mo Saigo no Hitokakera mo
lyrics.en: Both the first word and the last fragment
lyrics.zh: 最初的一句話，還有最後的一片碎片

lyrics.ja: 眩しい思い出にしよう
lyrics.en: Let's make them dazzling memories
lyrics.zh: 都讓它成為耀眼的回憶吧

lyrics.ja: さあ　まだまだいけるよ　止まれないから
lyrics.romaji: Saa Mada Mada Ikeru yo Tomarenai kara
lyrics.en: Now, we can still go on—because we can't stop
lyrics.zh: 來吧，還能繼續下去，因為停不下來

lyrics.ja: 元気よく、すごいよく！
lyrics.en: Cheerfully, amazingly well!

lyrics.ja: らららっていけ！　高鳴っていけ！　Gogogo！
lyrics.romaji: Rararara tte Ike! Takanaatte Ike! Gogogo!
lyrics.en: Go with a la-la-la! Let it pound! Go, go, go!
lyrics.zh: 啦啦啦地前進！心跳高鳴！Gogogo！

lyrics.ja: マルゴトミライ！
lyrics.en: All of it, the future!

lyrics.ja: 笑顔でマルゴトミライ！
lyrics.en: With a smile—all of it, the future!
lyrics.zh: 帶著笑容，全部都是未來！

lyrics.ja: 元気にマルゴトミライ！
lyrics.en: Cheerfully—all of it, the future!
lyrics.zh: 精神飽滿地，全部都是未來！

lyrics.ja: ちっちゃくマルゴトミライ！
lyrics.en: In a small way—all of it, the future!

lyrics.ja: でっかくマルゴトミライ！
lyrics.en: In a big way—all of it, the future!

lyrics.ja: 全力マルゴトミライ！
lyrics.en: Full power—all of it, the future!

lyrics.ja: ああ　キラリ光った　今、目が合った
lyrics.romaji: Aa Kirari Hikatta Ima, Me ga Atta
lyrics.en: Ah, it sparkled—now our eyes met
lyrics.zh: 啊啊，閃了一下，現在眼神交會了

lyrics.ja: たくさんの大切たちと
lyrics.en: With so many precious things
lyrics.zh: 與許許多多重要的事物

lyrics.ja: いつまでだって　どこまでだって
lyrics.romaji: Itsu made Datte Doko made Datte
lyrics.en: Forever and ever, anywhere at all
lyrics.zh: 無論到何時，無論到何處

lyrics.ja: 踊り明かそうか　キラリ
lyrics.en: Shall we dance until dawn? Sparkle

lyrics.ja: 確かめちゃお！　いくぞミライ
lyrics.en: Let's make sure! Here we go, future
lyrics.zh: 來確認一下吧！要去了，未來

lyrics.ja: さあ　夢よ叶って　もう鳴り出してる
lyrics.romaji: Saa Yume yo Kanatte Mou Naridashiteru
lyrics.en: Now, dream, come true—it's already ringing
lyrics.zh: 來吧，夢想實現吧，已經開始鳴響了

lyrics.ja: 音に漂った　ヒカリ
lyrics.en: Light drifting in the sound

lyrics.ja: ずっと　ずっと
lyrics.en: Forever, forever

lyrics.ja: 夢見た彼方！！
lyrics.en: The far beyond I dreamed of!!

lyrics.ja: わー！　声を出そうぜ　心はそう絶対に
lyrics.romaji: Waa! Koe wo Dasou ze Kokoro ha Sou Zettai ni
lyrics.en: Whoa! Let's raise our voices—our hearts absolutely
lyrics.zh: 哇！大聲喊出來吧，心絕對是

lyrics.ja: ミライむきでワハハ
lyrics.en: Facing the future with a ha-ha

lyrics.ja: よっしゃ、よっしゃ！
lyrics.en: Alright, alright!

lyrics.ja: 目と目あわせ　乾杯！
lyrics.en: Eyes meeting eyes—cheers!
